idea-plugin.name: Launch Settings Editor
idea-plugin.description:
Structural editor for Properties/launchSettings.json in JetBrains Rider.

When a .NET Launch Settings Profile run configuration is selected in the Run/Debug Configurations dialog, the built-in "open in editor" link in the "Profile parameters are set by …" hint is redirected to a form-based editor instead of opening the raw file. If the file does not exist yet, a Create launchSettings.json button appears next to the Launch profile selector.

Features

  • Profile list on the left with +/− add/remove, mirroring the run configuration tree.
  • Form on the right: name, command (Project / Executable / IISExpress), command line arguments, executable path, working directory, application URL, launch browser + launch URL, native debugging. Fields that are irrelevant for the selected command are disabled.
  • Environment variables edited in a table with common variable suggestions (ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT, DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT, Logging__LogLevel__Default, …) and matching value pickers; everything stays freely typeable.
  • Lossless round-trip: only known fields are touched — $schema, dotnetRunMessages and any other custom keys are preserved.
  • "Edit as JSON text…" escape hatch for anything the form does not cover.
  • Writes go through the IntelliJ VFS so Rider picks up the change immediately.

Compatible with Rider 2026.3.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0
  • Initial release: form-based launchSettings.json editor reachable from the run configuration dialog's "open in editor" link.
  • Fallback create button when the file is missing.
  • Environment-variable table with common-variable and value suggestions.
  • JSON text editing as an escape hatch.
